```{r}
install.packages("evd")
```

```{r}
library(MASS) #fitting distribusi
library (stats) #uji ks
library(moments) #skewness & kurtosis
library(ggplot2) #visualisasi
library(evd)
library(fitdistrplus)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/User/Downloads/Dataset fix.csv")
```

```{r}
head(data)
```

```{r}
# Ubah jadi numerik, ganti string yang tidak dapat dikonversi ke NA
data$Curah_Hujan <- as.numeric(data$Curah_Hujan)

# Hapus NA dan nominal tak valid
data_bersih <- na.omit(data$Curah_Hujan)
data_positif <- data_bersih[data_bersih > 0]

# Cek hasilnya
length(data_positif)
head(data_positif)

```

```{r}
# Weibull
fit_weibull <- fitdist(data, "weibull")

# Lognormal
fit_lognorm <- fitdist(data, "lnorm")

# Gumbel (menggunakan dist dari 'evd')
fit_gumbel <- fgev(data, type="GEV")  # GEV dengan shape = 0 = Gumbel
# Paksa shape=0
fit_gumbel$estimate["shape"] <- 0

```

```{r}
# Estimasi dan fitting distribusi: gunakan log-normal (sering cocok untuk curah hujan)
fit <- fitdistr(data_positif[data_positif > 0], "lognormal")
meanlog <- fit$estimate['meanlog']
sdlog <- fit$estimate['sdlog']

```

```{r}
sdlog_new <- sdlog * 0.6
meanlog_new <- meanlog

```

```{r}
simulasi_baru <- rlnorm(length(data_positif), meanlog_new, sdlog_new)
kurtosis(simulasi_baru)
```

```{r}
# Fungsi invers CDF distribusi log-normal
inverse_cdf <- function(u) {
  qlnorm(u, meanlog, sdlog)
}
```

```{r}
# Pembangkitan bilangan acak uniform
set.seed(123)
n <- 1000
u <- runif(n)
```

```{r}
# Generate data simulasi menggunakan inverse transform sampling
simulasi <- inverse_cdf(u)
```

```{r}
# Analisis statistik deskriptif data asli 
stat_asli <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(data_positif),
  Median = median(data_positif),
  Skewness = skewness(data_positif),
  Kurtosis = kurtosis(data_positif)
)

stat_simulasi <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(simulasi),
  Median = median(simulasi),
  Skewness = skewness(simulasi),
  Kurtosis = kurtosis(simulasi)
)

print("Statistik Data Asli:")
print(stat_asli)
```

```{r}
# Analisis statistik deskriptif data simulasi
stat_simulasi <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(simulasi_baru),
  Median = median(simulasi_baru),
  Skewness = skewness(simulasi_baru),
  Kurtosis = kurtosis(simulasi_baru)
)

print("Statistik Data Simulasi:")
print(stat_simulasi)
```

```{r}
# Visualisasi perbandingan histogram, density, dan CDF
df_asli <- data.frame(nilai = data_positif, jenis = "Data Asli")
df_sim <- data.frame(nilai = simulasi, jenis = "Simulasi")
df_all <- rbind(df_asli, df_sim)
```

```{r}
hist <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = nilai, fill = jenis)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
                 position = "identity",
                 alpha = 0.5,
                 bins = 40) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Data Asli" = "blue",
                               "Simulasi" = "pink")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 300)) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram Curah Hujan",
    x = "Curah Hujan (mm)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Jenis Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

hist
```

```{r}
density <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = nilai, color = jenis)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Data Asli" = "#1E40AF",
                                "Simulasi" = "#B91C1C")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 300)) +
  labs(
    title = "Kurva Density Curah Hujan",
    x = "Curah Hujan (mm)",
    y = "Density",
    color = "Jenis Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

density
```

```{r}
#plot cdf
ggplot(df_all, aes(x = nilai, color = jenis)) +
  stat_ecdf(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Data Asli" = "blue", 
                                "Simulasi" = "red")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 300)) +   # 🔥 memperbaiki tampilan CDF
  labs(
    title = "Fungsi Distribusi Kumulatif (CDF)",
    x = "Curah Hujan (mm)",
    y = "Empirical CDF",
    color = "Jenis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# Validasi dengan uji Kolmogorov-Smirnov
ks_test <- ks.test(simulasi, "plnorm", meanlog, sdlog)
print("Hasil Uji Kolmogorov-Smirnov Simulasi vs Distribusi Lognormal:")
print(ks_test)
```
